title: Realme P4s to debut next week with an 8,000mAh battery
description: Realme has confirmed that it will add another model to its P4 lineup in India. Called the Realme P4s, the upcoming smartphone will pack an 8,000mAh battery and be powered by the Dimensity 7400 Ultra chipset. The Realme P4s is making its way to the country on August 26, the company confirmed in an X post. An official teaser page on the company’s website has also revealed the phone’s key specs and its design. description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE has already been the subject of several leaks, including official-looking renders and even a hands-on video. Now, a major leak has surfaced, revealing almost everything about the upcoming smartphone. Android Headlines has shared 26 new marketing images of the Galaxy S26 FE, revealing the phone's key specs, features, and color options. According to the leaked images, the Galaxy S26 FE will be available in Blueberry, Graphite, and Pistachio color options. title: vivo Y31t launches with Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC, 7,200 mAh battery
description: The vivo Y31t leaked a few days ago, and now the company has made it official without any fanfare, just a listing on its Indian website. The Y31t comes with a 6.75-inch LCD screen with 720x1608 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 1,250-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 SoC. It has a 50MP rear camera with a 2MP depth sensor next to it, an 8MP selfie camera, and a 7,200 mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging. title: Redmi M100 goes official with a 7,900 mAh battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC
description: The Redmi M100 has become official in China, having been quietly listed on the Xiaomi website. The phone has a 6.9-inch LCD screen with a 720x1600 resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate, and 825-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 SoC. It has a 13MP rear camera, a 5MP selfie camera, and a 7,900 mAh battery with support for 45W fast charging. The phone runs HyperOS 3. It measures 170.12 x 78.42 x 8.8 mm and weighs 232g. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE's European Energy Label leaks
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE has been leaking a lot lately, which makes us think that its launch is imminent. Today its European Energy Label has been leaked ahead of its publication in the official database, and it reveals an overall A rating for the device. Its battery life is rated at exactly 50h, its drop resistance is rated A, and its repairability is rated C. Its battery is rated to last at least 1,200 cycles before the capacity drops below 80%. description: According to a new report, Google wants to stop making any Pixel products in China next year. That includes smartphones, of course, but also smartwatches and earbuds. In recent years Google has been extending its production capacity in Vietnam and India to reduce its reliance on China, but a "significant" portion of Pixel products are still made in China. The 2027 timeline came from Google's successful development and production of Pixel phones in Vietnam this year. title: iPhone 18 Pro's chipset tipped to be 18 percent faster than predecessor
description: The iPhone 18 Pro series is expected to launch next month with Apple's A20 Pro chipset, which is rumored to be manufactured using TSMC's 2nm process. A new leak now claims that the chipset will offer improved performance and efficiency, but at a higher cost than its predecessor. According to tipster Fixed Focus Digital on Weibo, the A20 Pro chipset will deliver around 18% higher performance than the A19 Pro and will use TSMC's new Gate-All-Around (GAA) process. title: Spotify expands User Notes, adds Playlist Notes to its top editor-curated playlists
description: Last month, Spotify added new features like Running Mode and User Notes. Now the streamer is building on the latter idea with Playlist Notes. These will be used by Spotify’s global team of playlist editors to explain the thinking behind the given playlist – why was a song included in this particular list and what makes it culturally relevant? To get the answer to those questions, head to one of the big playlists and hit the Notes button at the top. There is a caveat to this – the Notes feature is available to users (16 and older) in the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Australia and New...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra render leaks
description: Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra alongside the Galaxy Tab S12+ very soon, perhaps in early September, since that's when its previous generation flagship tablets were announced. Ahead of that, today a rather low resolution render that purports to depict the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has been leaked, and you can see it below. This confirms that the tablet will have S Pen support and two rear cameras, just like its predecessor. title: YouTube revises view counting
description: YouTube creators will soon see higher view counts for their videos as the platform announced a change in the way it handles viewership. From August 24 onward, a view on YouTube will count as soon as the video starts. This is the same metric that was applied to YouTube Shorts last year and the approach used on other platforms like TikTok and Instagram. YouTube explained in a blog post that creators expressed their desire for a unified view counting system which would “eliminate metric confusion” and bring a more accurate assessment of total exposure. title: Samsung details the new Warranty and care menu in One UI 9
description: One UI 9, which made its debut on the recently launched Galaxy Z Fold8, Fold8 Ultra, and Flip8, brings with it a new Warranty and care menu in Settings. It is here that you can keep track of your warranty periods and expiration dates across all of your Samsung devices, with the information being consolidated into one place. The device in use is displayed at the top of the screen, including its eligibility for enrollment into Samsung Care+. title: Apple is losing the antitrust battle and soon won't be able to charge commissions from external payment platforms
description: Apple has been fighting antitrust regulators across the globe, and it's about to lose yet another battle in the US after trying to take commissions from purchases made on third-party payment platforms.In the latest regulatory filing from Apple itself, the company admits that it may no longer be able to do so. The EU Commission was the first to force Apple to allow third-party app stores on its platform offering a way around the company's official App Store 30% fee on each purchase, including in-app purchases. description: Today Samsung has announced that Samsung Wallet now supports Digital Key access for Volkswagen EVs, including the ID. Polo, ID. Cross, ID.3neo, ID.4, ID.5, ID.7, and ID. Buzz. This is currently rolling out in Europe for vehicles running ID. software version 6.0.1. Only vehicles produced on or after April 27, 2026 are compatible, and they need to be equipped with the "Preparation for Digital Key" option package. description: As expected, iQOO announced its Neo11 Ultra and Z11S in China today. description: Earlier this month, Poco launched the M8 Power in India with an 8,000mAh battery. The company then began teasing the M8x 5G in the country late last week.
